profitTarget.quote: Phase 1 profit target: 6% | Phase 2 profit target: 6%

dailyLoss.measuredOn: higher of balance or equity at start of day (00:00 GMT+2) x 3%; breach measured on current equity
dailyLoss.reset: 00:00 broker time (GMT+2; GMT+3 during US daylight saving per T&C)
dailyLoss.quote: Alpha Pro 6% - Based on balance or equity, whichever is greater: 3% | The starting balance and equity refer to the account balance and equity at the end of the trading day/beginning of the daily candle (broker time), which is 00:00 GMT+2. | Regardless of whether balance or equity is used for the daily drawdown calculation, breaches are always applied based on open trades (unrealised losses) and, therefore, on the account's current equity value.

minTradingDays.perDayRequirement: Trading day = a day on which a trade is both opened and closed; a trade opened one day and closed another counts as one trading day
minTradingDays.quote: Minimum trading days (for each phase): 3 | Please note that we define a trading day as a day on which you open and close a trade on the same day. A trade opened on one day and closed on a different day will count as a single trading day.
minTradingDays.notes: No maximum trading days; 30-day (consecutive calendar days) inactivity deactivates the account.

consistency.notes: No consistency/best-day rule appears in evaluation rules (plan articles, T&C Schedule 1). No explicit sentence 'no consistency in evaluation' found.

consistency.measuredOn: net profit per day (closed vs floating not specified)
consistency.condition: Only with the On-Demand performance fee option (not with Bi-weekly)
consistency.quote: Alpha Pro, Swing, One, and Three: 40% | The consistency score is a simple calculation: the net profits generated on your best day are divided by the total net profits on the account. | If the result is greater than 0.40 (40%), the trader is not complying with the consistency rule.
consistency.notes: Total = net profits of the current payout window (partial withdrawal resets; a new trade opens a new window; leftover from the previous window is excluded). Day boundary not stated in this article (broker day 00:00 GMT+2 is defined only for daily DD). Also requires min 2% gross profit.

consistency.measuredOn: trading days (open and close on same day)
consistency.condition: Only with the Bi-weekly payout option; requests every 14 days from first QA trade
consistency.quote: For your first performance fee request, a minimum of 5 trading days using the same trading strategy is required. | The minimum performance fee amount is $100 ($100 gross, $80 net).
consistency.notes: Bi-weekly option: no best-day rule; min 5 trading days before the FIRST payout + $100 min profit; minimal lot sizes to farm days not allowed.

otherBreachRules.text: Payout (On-Demand): min 2% gross profit on Pro/Swing/One/Three.
otherBreachRules.quote: Alpha Pro, Swing, One, and Three: a minimum of 2% of gross profits on the account balance.

otherBreachRules.text: Max Risk Rule (Qualified accounts purchased after 21/07/2026): open (floating) loss per asset, losing positions combined, same-direction re-entries within 10 min chained; 3% for $5K-$25K, 2% for $50K-$200K. Hard breach (account closed).
otherBreachRules.quote: This rule applies to Qualified Accounts only. It takes effect for accounts purchased after the announcement date of 21/07/2026; accounts acquired before this date are not subject to it.

otherBreachRules.text: Inactivity: >30 consecutive calendar days without trading deactivates the account (irreversible).
otherBreachRules.quote: This means that if an Alpha Capital Group Analyst does not trade their account for more than 30 consecutive days, the account will be deactivated.

otherBreachRules.text: 2-minute rule: average trade duration > 2 min and >= 50% of profits from trades > 2 min; breach = restart evaluation / QA profits removed.
otherBreachRules.quote: We require the average duration of all your trades to be greater than 2 minutes.

otherBreachRules.text: Gambling / all-or-nothing: profits removed, possible termination.
otherBreachRules.quote: Activity of this nature will result in the removal of profits and may include termination of the contract and closure of your Qualified Account.

otherBreachRules.text: Qualified (Pro): holding over the weekend not allowed — soft breach (profits from those trades removed, account kept if above max DD).
otherBreachRules.quote: Doing so with a Pro Qualified account will incur a soft breach, meaning the profits from those trades are removed, but the trader keeps the account active, provided the updated balance does not fall below the maximum allowed drawdown.

differencesVsCatalog: No change in targets/daily/max/min-days vs catalog.

dailyLoss nuance: official daily article computes the 3% on the higher of balance/equity at the START of the day (00:00 GMT+2), so the $ amount floats (e.g. 3% of $101,000) — not a fixed % of initial balance.

Sizes: catalog lists up to $300K; official site title says 'Evaluation up to $200K' and help articles refer to 'Qualified Accounts of up to $200,000' ($300K appears only in stale lot-size tables). Treat $300K as not currently sold unless confirmed.

Missing in catalog: Max Risk Rule (new hard-breach rule on QA accounts bought after 21/07/2026: 2-3% floating loss per asset), 2-minute average trade duration rule, 30-day inactivity, Bi-weekly payout path (5 trading days before first payout, $100 min).
